name: Remeelnie
source:
Remeelnie – is a character of Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and a Queen Annor.
Remeelnie is a big adult dark-blue blue-eyed female annor, wearing dark "dress" and equiped with nearly black long ears. Remeelnie does have "eyebrows" in a form of 5 blue plates attached to each other. She has a dark chest "plate" and dark elbow pads. Remeelnie's forehead has 2 spikes, heading down. She does have 2 straight "whiskers". Remeelnie's head is decorated by hair-like bright blue crystals. Remeelnie's belly is covered with plates, hands have a sharp claw each.
Remeelnie is a polite and curious adult female annor. Ends her sentences with "yes-yes" sometimes. At one hand she doesn't like om'verai for what they have done to annors, at same time Remeelnie spies on Azaries, believing in a main heroine's kindness. Remeelnie is interested in om'verai's culture. Talks in poems.
Remeelnie is the very first character to appear in the videogame.
